content: For newly diagnosed adults suspected of having Type 8 diabetes, the investigation process involves age-based pathways and the interpretation of C-peptide test results as follows: 1. If the C-peptide level is greater than 600 pmol/L, the diagnosis is most likely Type 2 diabetes. 2. If the C-peptide level falls between 200 and 600 pmol/L, the result is considered indeterminate. In such cases, it is recommended to possibly repeat the C-peptide test after a period of 5 years to reassess. 3. If the C-peptide level is less than 200 pmol/L, the diagnosis is most likely Type 1 diabetes.
